verdict: Spend doubled while leads held flat — Google efficiency needs immediate correction.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 22 confirmed leads at a cost of $153.27 per lead — a cost that more than doubled week-over-week as Google Ads spend surged while lead volume stayed flat. Meta is carrying the full confirmed lead load (22 leads on $977.83), while Google Ads spent $2,394.04 and returned only 6 conversions, implying a cost per lead nearly ten times Meta's. We are scrutinizing the Google Local Services campaign — which accounts for $1,437 of that spend — before any further budget is committed there. Separately, 91 pipeline opportunities were created this period but none have converted to appointments or signed matters, which points to an intake process issue we are addressing directly; expect a resolution plan this week.
